description: Flat schema for dependency reachability analysis. 4 fields.

call_chain.description: Import/call chain from app code to vulnerable function
call_chain.title: Call Chain

direct.description: Whether the dependency is direct or transitive
direct.title: Direct

reachable.description: Whether the vulnerable function is actually called
reachable.title: Reachable

vulnerable_function.description: The vulnerable function/method in the dependency
vulnerable_function.title: Vulnerable Function

title: ReachabilityProof
